variants.name: Meadow
variants.atmosphere: A radius-three grassy clearing surrounds the shrine, edged with a continuous bush rim. Outside, bushes occupy 15% of cells; no grass or ordinary flowers. Three wild roses remain as special finds.

variants.name: Mushroom Grove
variants.atmosphere: Staggered mushroom pairs repeat every six cells, with shrubs and grass between them. The close-set caps lead to a crescent and its luminous flower.

variants.name: Orchard
variants.atmosphere: Repeated tree avenues end at three unfamiliar fruits.

variants.name: Formal Garden
variants.atmosphere: An orderly aisle connects mirrored beds; two matching roses break the repeated blue and gold.

variants.name: Hedge Garden
variants.atmosphere: Sixteen garden rooms form a clear 4 × 4 square. The POI is centered in an inner room, framed by four marigolds. Two roses distinguish the far corner rooms.

variants.name: Ancient Grove
variants.atmosphere: Rounded tree, bush and grass clusters repeat seven cells apart. A light scatter of grass crosses the gaps; stone markers lead from the central grove to its guarded starflower.

variants.name: Stone Garden
variants.atmosphere: Three concentric stone rings surround the POI, with softer grass rings between. Every fifth stone is iron, creating a regular metallic rhythm through the circles.

variants.name: Ordered Graves
variants.atmosphere: Short grave rows leave an aisle; matching finds occupy two empty row ends.

variants.name: Overgrown Graves
variants.atmosphere: Vegetation follows the old rows; a deliberate gap opens onto a lone flower.

variants.name: Broken Masonry
variants.atmosphere: Repeated piles suggest fallen walls; one displaced line ends at a platinum-bearing rock guarded by a slime.

variants.name: Silent Circle
variants.atmosphere: Nearly closed stone circles share a single grass-marked opening. Their repeated entrances point toward the POI and a lone flower beyond.

variants.name: Flint Field
variants.atmosphere: A radius-three flint circle surrounds the POI, edged with a continuous rubble rim. Rubble scatters at 15% outside; three gemfruit finds remain.

variants.name: Broken Depot
variants.atmosphere: Repeated rubble piles are threaded with traps. An offset line leads toward two finds; the broken order suggests an ambush.

variants.name: Seep
variants.atmosphere: Repeated tar-pit clusters seep around small rubble islands. A lone flower survives beyond the last dark crescent.

variants.name: Work Yard
variants.atmosphere: Copper-rock rows and rubble columns enclose twenty-five plots. The POI sits in the central room; a crimson-bearing rock marks the far end of its lane.

variants.name: Black Ring
variants.atmosphere: Smaller, near-continuous rubble circles enclose tight tar rings. The circles repeat every eight cells; two gold-bearing rocks stand at the far side.
